label: A first being is in POTENCY_2 in no respect at the time now
paraphrase: Time-indexed sibling of STMT-FIRST-BEING-IS-IN-NO-WAY-IN-POTENCY: whatever first being (no being other than it is simply prior to it, by nature, untimed) is in potency in no respect at the supplied time now, with InPotencyAt the free POTENCY_2 parameter at each time. It says nothing about other times, so it does not give immutability or eternity; it is not identified with the untimed statement, whose consumers pass from pure actuality to immutability and eternity.
